privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Absolute commitment to confidentiality, security, and responsible management of your data.
privacy.intro: At Net & Soft Solutions (hereinafter, "Net & Soft"), we deeply value the trust you place in us. This Privacy Policy transparently describes how we collect, use, store, and safeguard personal and corporate information provided through our website and during the provision of our software development, network infrastructure, CCTV security systems, and specialized technical support services.

sections.title: Data Controller
sections.content: The controller responsible for processing personal data gathered through this platform is Net & Soft Solutions, domiciled in San Fernando de Apure, Apure State, Venezuela. You may contact our privacy and technical support desk via email at info{'@'}netandsoft.com.ve or by phone at +58 414-478-5215.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect only information necessary to deliver consultation and execute requested technical services:
• Contact Details: Full name, email address, phone number, and company name when submitting quotation forms or inquiries via WhatsApp.
• Project Data: Technical requirements, software specifications, network topologies, or surveillance requirements provided voluntarily.
• Technical Browsing Data: Standard technical data such as anonymized IP address, browser type, and display resolution, utilized exclusively to optimize user experience and platform performance.

sections.title: Purpose and Use of Information
sections.content:
Collected data is used strictly for the following legitimate purposes:
• Preparing technical estimates, formal quotations, and customized technical proposals.
• Executing, implementing, and maintaining contracted technological services (web development, structured cabling, security cameras, and IT support).
• Providing continuous technical assistance and operational support.
• Issuing commercial invoices and fulfilling contractual and legal obligations.

sections.title: Confidentiality & Security Measures
sections.content: We implement robust cybersecurity protocols to protect your information against unauthorized access, modification, loss, or disclosure. This includes SSL/TLS encrypted communications (HTTPS), access-restricted secure storage, and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) signed with our technical and engineering personnel.

sections.title: No Data Selling or Third-Party Sharing
sections.content: Net & Soft Solutions does not sell, lease, trade, or transfer personal data or customer databases to third parties for commercial or advertising purposes. Technical details are communicated strictly to essential infrastructure providers (cloud hosting or authorized communication gateways) or when mandated by competent judicial authorities under applicable law.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as long as a commercial or support relationship remains active, or as required by applicable accounting and fiscal statutory retention periods.

sections.title: Data Subject Rights
sections.content: As a data subject, you have the right to request access, correction, update, or deletion of your personal data from our contact registries at any time. To exercise these rights, please submit a formal request to info{'@'}netandsoft.com.ve; we will respond within a maximum of 5 business days.

sections.title: Third-Party External Services
sections.content: Our website includes direct links to third-party services, such as WhatsApp (Meta Platforms) and interactive location maps (Google Maps). These platforms operate under their own independent privacy policies, and we recommend reviewing them when interacting with them.

sections.title: Modifications to This Policy
sections.content: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy to reflect legislative changes, legal precedents, or technological enhancements in our services. Any modifications will be promptly published on this page with an updated revision date.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Clear guidelines regarding scope, contracting, warranties, and technical service delivery.
terms.intro: Welcome to Net & Soft Solutions. These Terms and Conditions govern access to and use of this website, as well as the contracting and delivery framework for our professional services in Software Development, Network & IT Infrastructure, CCTV Surveillance Systems, and Specialized Technical Support. By browsing our website or contracting our services, you agree to these terms in full.

sections.title: Acceptance and Legal Capacity
sections.content: By accessing this website or formally requesting a quotation or service, you confirm that you are of legal age with full capacity to contract or legally represent the company or entity on whose behalf you act, agreeing to be bound by these terms.

sections.title: Scope of Technological Services
sections.content:
Net & Soft Solutions provides comprehensive technology solutions covering:
• Software Development: Custom web, mobile, and corporate software built to approved technical specifications.
• Networks & Infrastructure: Design, installation, and configuration of structured cabling, fiber optics, routers, switches, and secure wireless networks.
• CCTV Systems: Supply, mounting, and configuration of video surveillance cameras (IP, analog), DVR/NVR recorders, and secure remote access.
• Technical Support: Preventive, corrective maintenance, fault troubleshooting, and on-site or remote assistance under agreed service agreements.

sections.title: Estimates, Quotations, and Contracts
sections.content: All commercial proposals or quotations issued by Net & Soft Solutions have a validity period specified in the document (typically 15 continuous days due to hardware and licensing market fluctuations). Large-scale projects are formalized through a service contract or signed technical proposal defining delivery milestones, schedule, and payment terms.

sections.title: Intellectual Property and Licensing
sections.content:
• Website Content: All logos, texts, graphic elements, source code of this website, and trademarks are the exclusive property of Net & Soft Solutions or properly licensed.
• Custom Developed Software: Unless agreed otherwise in writing, upon full payment of project fees, the client acquires usage rights or ownership of custom code as established in the individual development agreement. Third-party open source libraries remain governed by their respective licenses (MIT, Apache, GPL, etc.).

sections.title: Client Responsibilities
sections.content:
For optimal service execution, the client agrees to:
• Provide truthful information, clear technical specifications, and necessary access credentials (servers, physical premises) within coordinated deadlines.
• Possess proper licenses for pre-existing software or systems within their infrastructure.
• Ensure adequate physical and electrical conditions for installing network hardware and CCTV equipment.

sections.title: Warranties and After-Sales Support
sections.content:
• Hardware & Equipment: Installed equipment (cameras, switches, routers, servers) includes official manufacturer warranties, managed by our technical team in accordance with manufacturer policies.
• Physical Installations: Cabling and physical mounting installations carry a technical warranty against installation defects.
• Custom Software: We provide a post-launch technical warranty period (defined in contract) for resolving errors attributable to original development at no additional cost.

sections.title: Exclusions and Limitation of Liability
sections.content:
Net & Soft Solutions is not liable for service interruptions or damages resulting from:
• Outages caused by third-party Internet Service Providers (ISPs), electrical power surges, or power outages outside backup UPS systems.
• Unauthorized tampering, modifications to code, or configuration changes carried out by non-Net & Soft personnel.
• Cyberattacks or security breaches caused by weak internal passwords or client negligence.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.content: Both parties agree to maintain strict confidentiality regarding all technical, financial, commercial, and strategic information exchanged during negotiation or execution of any project, safeguarding trade secrets of each party.

sections.title: Modifications to Terms
sections.content: Net & Soft Solutions may update these Terms & Conditions at any time to reflect new service offerings, regulatory changes, or security protocols. Terms in effect at the time of formal contracting will govern that specific project.

sections.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. Any disputes shall preferably be settled through amicable and good-faith negotiation; failing agreement, disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts of San Fernando de Apure.
